name: Ishikari (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ishikari city emblem in blue, green and red: a blue stylised sprout with green leaves and a red leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Ishikari, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 23 February 1996.

features.role: Ishikari city emblem — a blue stylised sprout with green leaves and a red leaf
